patthana11.15:1.1: Nasavitakkasavicāraṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naavitakkavicāramattaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naavitakkaavicāraṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:3.1: Napītisahagataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasukhasahagataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naupekkhāsahagataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:5.1: Nadassanena pahātabbaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:7.1: Nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:9.1: Naācayagāmiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naapacayagāmiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:11.1: Nasekkhaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naasekkhaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanevāsekkhanāsekkhaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:13.1: Naparittaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… namahaggataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naappamāṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:15.1: Naparittārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… namahaggatārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naappamāṇārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:16.1: Nahīnaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… namajjhimaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… napaṇītaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:18.1: Namicchattaniyataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasammattaniyataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naaniyataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:20.1: Namaggārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… namaggahetukaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… namaggādhipatiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:21.1: Naanuppannaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nauppādiṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:22.1: Naatītaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāgataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:23.1: Naatītārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naanāgatārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… napaccuppannārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:24.1: Naajjhattaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nabahiddhā nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.15:25.1: Naajjhattārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nabahiddhārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
